hooks.name: Workspace Scope Restrict
hooks.description: Block tool operations outside Porto workspace

action.command: if ($input.tool -match "read_file|read_code|file_search|grep_search|list_directory|fs_write|str_replace|fs_append|delete_file|smart_relocate|semantic_rename|invoke_sub_agent|control_pwsh_process") { $file = $input.arguments.path; $cwd = $input.arguments.cwd; $target = $file; if (-not $target -and $cwd) { $target = $cwd } if ($target -and $target -notmatch "^c:\\\\Reavlenia Arezha\\\\Porto") { Write-Output '{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"File/directory operation outside workspace scope detected: ' + $target + '\"}}'; exit 2 } }
